import parse

# Various test cases
tests = [
    ('{:<}', 'hello world'),
    ('{:^}', '  hello  world'),
    ('{:.<5}', 'xxhelloxxworld'),
    ('{:.^5}', 'xxhelloxxworld'),
]

for fmt, s in tests:
    r = parse.search(fmt, s)
    print(f'search({fmt!r}, {s!r}) -> {r}')
